scope: SteveSpivak/LG-TV service-to-feature dependency map. Cloud-inspection only; every edge carries the strongest classification the in-repo evidence supports.

classification_policy.PROVEN: in-repo runtime receipts/captures demonstrate the edge on the physical TV
classification_policy.OBSERVED: repo scripts/docs target or describe the edge on the physical TV, but no committed runtime receipt
classification_policy.INFERRED: standard webOS platform knowledge; not demonstrated in this repo
classification_policy.UNKNOWN: no usable evidence in this repo; treat as not demonstrable and NOT disposable
classification_policy.rule: a service/daemon is NEVER disposable from its name; only a PROVEN-OFF experiment could downgrade, and none exists

protected_functions.definition: functions whose loss bricks the owner's daily use or removes the independent recovery path; any experiment touching them must hold a verified recovery route first
protected_functions.stop_rule: preflight must STOP (blocker, severity=blocker) unless every protected function is verified present/healthy; UNKNOWN counts as not-verified
